hub.welcomeLead: This is the official help hub for every app published by The Gifted Girl Kim LLC. Find answers, privacy policies, and direct support for each app — all in one place.
hub.contactIntro: We're here to help. Email us with your app name, device model, and what you were trying to do — we'll get back to you as soon as we can.

generalFaqs.question: How do I get help with an app?
generalFaqs.answer: Open the app's support page below, or email thegiftedgirlkim@gmail.com with the app name, your device model, and iOS or Android version.

generalFaqs.question: Where are the official privacy policies?
generalFaqs.answer: Each app has its own privacy policy on this website at thegiftedgirlkim.com/privacy/[app-name].html. These are the official store-ready links going forward.

generalFaqs.question: Do your apps sell my personal information?
generalFaqs.answer: No. The Gifted Girl Kim LLC does not sell personal information. Many apps process data locally on your device. See each app's privacy policy for details.

generalFaqs.question: How do I report a bug or request a feature?
generalFaqs.answer: Visit the individual app support page and use the Report a Bug or Feature Request buttons — they open a pre-filled email to our support team.

generalFaqs.question: What if my app isn't listed yet?
generalFaqs.answer: New apps are added here as they launch. If you downloaded an app from the App Store or Google Play and don't see it listed, email us and we'll point you to the right resources.

terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions apply to apps and digital products published by The Gifted Girl Kim LLC. This page is a placeholder and will be expanded as our studio grows.

sections.title: Use of Our Apps
sections.body: Our apps are provided for personal, lawful use. You agree to use them responsibly and in accordance with applicable laws and app store terms.

sections.title: No Warranty
sections.body: Apps are provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, to the fullest extent permitted by law. We work hard to build reliable tools, but we cannot guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, The Gifted Girl Kim LLC is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of our apps or website.

sections.title: App Store Purchases
sections.body: Purchases and subscriptions are processed by Apple or Google under their respective terms. Refund requests should be directed to the store where you purchased.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of our apps after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms? Email thegiftedgirlkim@gmail.com.

screenshot-goblin.dataCollected: Screenshot Goblin accesses your photo library only to find and manage screenshots. Scan results and selections stay on your device. We do not collect, upload, or store your photos on our servers.
screenshot-goblin.thirdPartyServices: No third-party analytics or advertising SDKs. App Store billing (when applicable) is handled by Apple.
knownIssues: Initial App Store release — check back for updates after launch.

faqs.question: Does Screenshot Goblin upload my photos?
faqs.answer: No. All scanning and review happens locally on your device. Nothing is uploaded to our servers.

faqs.question: Where do deleted screenshots go?
faqs.answer: Deleted screenshots move to your device's Recently Deleted / Trash folder, where you can recover them before permanent removal.

digital-chapel.dataCollected: Optional magic-link account email and user identifier; synced notes, highlights, saved scriptures, journey progress, and preferences when signed in; Chapel Plus entitlement records; Prayer Circle posts; sermon/song submission contact details and files; AI processing of selected Scripture when you use AI Bible Teacher; optional AI and community reports. Guest mode can use core features without an account.
digital-chapel.thirdPartyServices: Supabase (authentication and data sync); Google Gemini via our server-side Supabase infrastructure for AI Bible Teacher; Apple App Store / Google Play for Chapel Plus; on-device text-to-speech for narration.
knownIssues: Some features require an internet connection.
Subscription and billing help requires your store receipt.

faqs.question: Do I need an internet connection?
faqs.answer: Some features work offline; others — including account sign-in, sync, and community features — require internet access.

faqs.question: How do I manage my subscription?
faqs.answer: Subscriptions are managed through the Apple App Store or Google Play. Include your store receipt when emailing support for billing help.

memory-friend.dataCollected: Memory Friend stores journal entries, optional photo memories, optional voice recordings, routine progress, family connection details you enter, and app preferences on your device. We do not collect this content for advertising or resale.
memory-friend.thirdPartyServices: No third-party advertising. Speak Instead uses Apple’s on-device speech recognition when you tap the button — your spoken words are processed to fill your memory text and are not sold. Future cloud backup (if added) will be disclosed in-app before use.

marketing.headline: A Gentle Place for Memories, Routines, and Connection
intro: Memory Friend is a warm mobile app for saving meaningful moments, recording voice memories, adding photo memories, and keeping simple daily routines close.
Guided by a friendly lightbulb companion, Memory Friend is designed to feel calm, kind, and easy to use — especially for people who prefer speaking instead of typing.
features: Save personal memory journal entries — type or use Speak Instead
Record voice memories
Add treasured photo memories
Track daily routines
Keep family connection notes
Simple local privacy and support tools
marketing.builtFor: Memory Friend is not meant to feel complicated or clinical. It is a soft place to remember little moments, preserve familiar details, and create a comforting routine. Whether you want to save a story, remember a name, keep a daily checklist, or hold onto a voice note, Memory Friend gives you one simple place to begin.
marketing.disclaimer: Memory Friend is a personal memory and routine helper. It is not medical care, diagnosis, treatment, monitoring, or an emergency service. If there is an emergency, call local emergency services or contact a trusted caregiver immediately.

extraSections.title: Photos, Camera, Microphone, and Speak Instead
extraSections.body: Memory Friend may request access to your camera, photo library, or microphone only when you choose features such as photo memories, voice memories, or Speak Instead dictation. These items are for personal memory keeping inside the app. We do not sell your photos, recordings, journal entries, or family information.

extraSections.title: Local Storage and Cloud Sync
extraSections.body: Memory Friend currently saves memory content on your device unless a future cloud-sync feature is clearly added and enabled. If you uninstall the app or clear local app data, locally stored content may be deleted from that device.

extraSections.title: Health and Medical Disclaimer
extraSections.body: Memory Friend is a personal memory and routine helper. It is not medical care, diagnosis, treatment, monitoring, dementia screening, cognitive assessment, therapy, emergency response, or professional caregiving. If there is an emergency, call local emergency services or contact a trusted caregiver immediately.

extraSections.title: Data Deletion
extraSections.body: You can delete app data by using in-app reset options where available, clearing the app’s stored data in device Settings, or uninstalling the app. For privacy questions or deletion help, email thegiftedgirlkim@gmail.com.

faqs.question: Is my data private?
faqs.answer: Memory Friend is built for personal, private use. Your memories and reminders are intended to stay on your device unless a future feature clearly states otherwise.

faqs.question: How does Speak Instead work?
faqs.answer: When you tap Speak Instead, Memory Friend uses your device microphone and Apple speech recognition to turn your words into text in your memory entry. You can edit the text before saving. Speech is optional — you can always type instead.

meditation-journey-444.dataCollected: Meditation Journey-444 does not require an account. Session preferences may be stored locally on your device. We do not collect personal meditation content.
meditation-journey-444.thirdPartyServices: Apple App Store for purchases. No advertising SDKs.
knownIssues: If audio stops unexpectedly, force-close and reopen the app.

faqs.question: Audio won't play — what should I try?
faqs.answer: Force-close the app and reopen. Check your device volume and whether you're on Wi‑Fi or cellular. Email support with your device model if the issue continues.

mappy-navigation.dataCollected: Mappy Navigation uses precise or approximate location, destinations, route details, and search requests to provide maps, routing, navigation, nearby-place discovery, arrival help, and watch directions. Saved trips, Arrival Guides, preferences, and free AI Trip Designer usage counters are stored locally on your device. When you choose to use the optional AI Trip Designer, the trip-planning information you submit is sent through Mappy's backend server to Groq, the third-party AI provider Mappy uses to generate a suggested itinerary. Optional photos are accessed only when you choose to add one. We do not sell personal information or use it for third-party advertising.
mappy-navigation.thirdPartyServices: Map, search, routing, traffic, weather, and place-data providers used to deliver the feature you request; Groq, accessed through Mappy's backend server, for optional AI Trip Designer plans; Apple App Store and Google Play for purchases and subscription management; and native Apple Watch / Wear OS services for companion directions. Store providers process payments, and Mappy does not receive your complete card number.

marketing.headline: More than directions — a companion for the whole journey.
intro: Mappy keeps its proven map and navigation experience at the center, then adds useful tools before the drive, along the route, and after arrival.
Plan an AI-assisted trip, find practical stops, save Arrival Guides, and glance at the next turn, distance, and ETA from a paired Apple Watch or Wear OS watch.
features: Turn-by-turn navigation with route choices and friendly voice guidance
Mappy Guide for trip planning, saved places, and useful journey tools
AI Trip Designer with three complimentary plans each month
Arrival Guides for entrances, floors, parking notes, photos, and other details you save
Truck and freight search for truck stops, fuel, scales, rest areas, parking, and repair
Apple Watch and Wear OS companion directions during active phone navigation
Local data controls, feature suggestions, problem reporting, and store review links
Optional Mappy Plus subscription for unlimited AI Trip Designer access
marketing.builtFor: Mappy is built for everyday drivers, travelers, walkers, families, and freight professionals who want dependable navigation without losing the useful details surrounding the trip.
marketing.price: Core navigation remains available without a subscription. AI Trip Designer includes three complimentary plans per calendar month. Mappy Plus is $4.99 per month for unlimited AI Trip Designer use; store pricing and taxes may vary.
marketing.disclaimer: Navigation, traffic, weather, business, parking, fuel, scale, and arrival information may be delayed, incomplete, or inaccurate. Stay alert, obey signs and laws, and never interact with the app while driving. Watch directions require a compatible paired phone and watch. Mappy is not an emergency service.

extraSections.title: Location and Navigation
extraSections.body: Mappy requests location permission to show your position, calculate routes, provide active navigation, find nearby places, and share current route guidance with a paired watch. Location and route requests are sent to the map, search, routing, traffic, weather, or place-data provider needed for the feature you selected. You can manage location permission in device Settings.

extraSections.title: AI Trip Designer
extraSections.body: Mappy includes an optional AI-assisted Trip Designer. Information is sent for AI planning only when you choose to use that feature (for example, by creating a trip plan after reviewing the in-app AI notice). When you use AI Trip Designer, the trip-planning information you submit is sent through Mappy's backend server to Groq, the third-party AI provider Mappy uses to generate the suggested itinerary. Information that may be transmitted for an AI plan: origin (starting location text), destination or area text, trip duration/days, travel style/preferences, optional notes you enter about what matters most, verified road mileage and travel time from map routing, and verified nearby mapped places (name, place type, and coordinates) that Mappy already found through public map services. Information that is not included in the AI Trip Designer request: your name, email address, Apple ID, phone number, payment or card details, photos, Arrival Guides, saved trip notes beyond the current planning form, or a continuous live GPS track of your device. Do not enter sensitive personal information in trip notes. Retention: Mappy's trip-planner backend processes the request to create a plan and return it to your device. The Mappy trip-planner function does not save your AI prompts or AI responses in a Mappy database. Completed plans you choose to save remain on your device as local saves. Groq may temporarily retain or log requests under its own provider policies for system reliability or abuse monitoring unless otherwise configured in Groq account settings; see Groq's Your Data in GroqCloud documentation for current practices. Platform infrastructure that hosts Mappy's backend may also keep standard operational logs under that provider's terms. AI-generated travel suggestions may contain errors or be incomplete. Confirm hours, accessibility, weather, road conditions, and other important travel details independently before traveling.

extraSections.title: Saved Information and Optional Photos
extraSections.body: Saved trips, Arrival Guides, preferences, and usage counters are stored locally on your device unless a feature clearly tells you otherwise. Camera or photo-library access is used only when you choose to add an image. You can export or delete local Mappy data from the app. Uninstalling the app may also remove locally stored information.

extraSections.title: Watch Companion
extraSections.body: When navigation is active on your phone, Mappy may send the next maneuver, distance, remaining distance, ETA, street name, and arrival state to a paired Apple Watch or Wear OS watch. The watch companion does not replace the phone's navigation session and may not update if the devices disconnect.

extraSections.title: Subscriptions
extraSections.body: Mappy Plus purchases are processed by Apple or Google. Mappy receives purchase status needed to unlock features but does not receive your complete payment-card information. Deleting Mappy or its local data does not cancel a subscription; manage or cancel it through your App Store or Google Play account.

extraSections.title: Data Retention and Deletion
extraSections.body: Local Mappy data remains on your device until you delete it, clear app storage, or uninstall the app. Mappy does not save AI Trip Designer prompts or responses to a Mappy database. Information temporarily processed by service providers such as Groq is retained according to their policies and as needed to provide, secure, and troubleshoot the requested feature. For privacy or support requests, email thegiftedgirlkim@gmail.com.

knownIssues: GPS and reverse-geocoded street addresses can differ from a building's posted address, especially near property boundaries.
Business hours, parking, fuel prices, scales, building entrances, and indoor directions may be incomplete or outdated.
The watch companion requires a compatible paired watch, the latest Mappy version, and an active navigation session started on the phone.
plannedFeatures: Expanded walking and bicycle journey tools
More detailed arrival and entrance guidance

faqs.question: Why does Mappy need my location?
faqs.answer: Location permission powers the map, route calculation, active navigation, nearby searches, arrival help, and watch directions. You can manage permission in device Settings.

faqs.question: How does the watch companion work?
faqs.answer: Install Mappy on a compatible paired Apple Watch or Wear OS watch, start navigation on the phone, and keep the devices connected. The watch then shows key maneuver, distance, ETA, and arrival information.

faqs.question: Is AI Trip Designer free?
faqs.answer: You receive three complimentary AI-generated trip plans per calendar month. Mappy Plus provides unlimited AI Trip Designer access for $4.99 per month; store pricing and taxes may vary.

faqs.question: How do I manage or cancel Mappy Plus?
faqs.answer: Use Manage Subscription inside Mappy or open your Apple App Store or Google Play subscription settings. Deleting the app or local data does not cancel the store subscription.

faqs.question: How do I delete my information?
faqs.answer: Open Mappy's data controls to export or delete locally saved information. You may also clear app storage or uninstall the app. Email thegiftedgirlkim@gmail.com if you need privacy help.

faqs.question: Where can I report a problem or suggest a feature?
faqs.answer: Use Report a Problem or Suggest a Feature inside Mappy, or email thegiftedgirlkim@gmail.com with your device, app version, and a description of what happened.

afterlife-network.dataCollected: Afterlife Network may store account information for community features. Sensor and session data used in-app is processed to provide spirit communication tools. We do not sell personal information.
afterlife-network.thirdPartyServices: Backend services for community safety and account features. Apple App Store billing. See in-app privacy note for current providers.
knownIssues: Community features require internet access.
Some tools are intended for entertainment purposes.

faqs.question: Is Afterlife Network for entertainment?
faqs.answer: Yes — spirit communication tools are provided for entertainment and exploration. Community safety controls are built into the experience.

socialnature.dataCollected: SocialNature collects information you choose to provide when you create an account and use community features: email address, username, display name, wildlife photos, videos, discovery posts, comments, optional location for pins, and content reports. We use this data to run the app — feed, sharing, comments, Nature Race, collections, and moderation. We do not sell personal information and we do not use advertising trackers.
socialnature.thirdPartyServices: Account data, discoveries, photos, videos, and comments are stored with Supabase (secure cloud database and file storage). AI Nature Lens sends the photo you choose to Groq's vision API to suggest species or breed names; only that image is sent when you use Lens — not your whole photo library. Apple App Store and Google Play process downloads under their own privacy policies. No advertising SDKs.

extraSections.title: Account & Sign-In
extraSections.body: Creating an account requires an email address, password, and username. You can browse the discovery feed and use AI Nature Lens without signing in. Posting discoveries, commenting, liking, and uploading photos or videos requires an account. You may sign out at any time from the app.

extraSections.title: Photos, Videos & Community Content
extraSections.body: When you share a discovery, you may upload photos or videos, write titles and descriptions, and choose a category. Comments you post are visible to other users on that discovery. Please do not post private home addresses, phone numbers, or other sensitive personal information. Other users can view content you share publicly in the feed.

extraSections.title: Location
extraSections.body: Location is optional. If you add a discovery pin or share a find with location, you can choose approximate location (~1 km), exact GPS coordinates, or no coordinates (text only). Location is used for map pins, Nature Race, and nearby discovery features — only when you choose to include it.

extraSections.title: AI Nature Lens
extraSections.body: When you tap AI Nature Lens and submit a photo, that image is sent to Groq for automated identification (for example breed or species suggestions). Do not submit photos you do not want processed by our AI provider. Results are shown to you in the app; we do not use Lens photos for advertising.

extraSections.title: Reports & Safety
extraSections.body: You can report discoveries that feel inappropriate, spam, harassment, or misleading. Reports are reviewed by the developer. Email thegiftedgirlkim@gmail.com for urgent content concerns.

extraSections.title: Camera, Photos & Device Permissions
extraSections.body: The app may request camera access to take wildlife photos, photo library access to pick images or videos to share, and location access when you add pins or location-based features. Permissions are used only when you tap those features — not in the background for unrelated purposes.

extraSections.title: Data Retention & Deletion
extraSections.body: To request account deletion or removal of your content, email thegiftedgirlkim@gmail.com from the address tied to your account. We will process reasonable deletion requests in a timely manner. Uninstalling the app does not automatically delete cloud-stored account data.

knownIssues: First launch may ask for camera, photo, or location permission when you use those features — only needed for sharing or pins.
AI Nature Lens requires an internet connection and sends the photo you choose for identification.
If comments or video upload fail, the app backend may need a one-time update — email us and we will help.

marketing.headline: Discover nature. Share wonder. Meet Traveler the Turtle.
intro: SocialNature is a friendly wildlife community for explorers of all ages. Snap what you find outside, learn what it is, and share it with people who love nature too.
Traveler the Turtle guides you through discovery feeds, collection goals, the Nature Race between states, and optional map pins — with a calm, encouraging tone and no ads.
features: Live discovery feed from the SocialNature community
Share wildlife photos and videos from camera or gallery
Comments on discoveries — connect with other explorers
AI Nature Lens — identify breeds, species, flowers, and more from your photo
Discovery pins with optional approximate or exact location
Nature Race — friendly state-vs-state discovery competition
Collections — track birds, butterflies, flowers, wildlife, trees, and mushrooms
Report button on posts for content safety
Free to download — create an account to post and comment
marketing.builtFor: SocialNature is built for curious walkers, backyard naturalists, families, and anyone who notices something beautiful outside and wants to name it, save it, and share it — gently, without clutter or pressure.

faqs.question: Who is Traveler the Turtle?
faqs.answer: Traveler is the friendly guide in SocialNature — a rescued turtle with a big heart for wildlife. He cheers you on as you explore, share, and learn.

faqs.question: Do I need an account?
faqs.answer: You can browse the feed and try AI Nature Lens without signing in. Create a free account to post discoveries, comment, like, and upload photos or videos.

faqs.question: How does AI Nature Lens work?
faqs.answer: Open the Lens tab, take or choose a photo, and Traveler suggests a species or breed name plus a fun fact. The image you submit is processed by our AI provider to generate the result.

faqs.question: How do I report inappropriate content?
faqs.answer: Tap Report on any discovery in the feed, or email thegiftedgirlkim@gmail.com with the subject SocialNature Content Report. We review reports as quickly as we can.

faqs.question: Do you sell my photos or email?
faqs.answer: No. We do not sell personal information. Photos and posts are used to run the community features you choose to use.

faqs.question: How do I delete my account or data?
faqs.answer: Email thegiftedgirlkim@gmail.com from the address tied to your account with a deletion request. We will help you as soon as we can.

faqs.question: How do I contact support?
faqs.answer: Email thegiftedgirlkim@gmail.com with SocialNature in the subject line, your device type (iPhone or Android), and app version 1.1.0. Screenshots help us fix bugs faster.

faqs.question: How do I leave a review?
faqs.answer: Open SocialNature on the App Store or Google Play and tap Rate & Review. Thank you for supporting indie apps — Traveler appreciates it!

dream-board.dataCollected: Dreamy Board stores vision boards, journal entries, doodles, goals, vault items, and app preferences locally on your device. We do not upload your creative content to our servers or sell personal information.
dream-board.thirdPartyServices: No third-party advertising or analytics SDKs. Apple App Store and Google Play process purchases under their own privacy policies when applicable. Photo library access is used only when you choose to add images.

marketing.headline: Dream boldly. Plan gently. Create with Dreamy.
intro: Dreamy Board is a personal vision board, dream journal, doodle pad, and goal tracker — designed to help you dream boldly and follow through, guided by Dreamy the Cloud.
Build boards for travel, home, career, and life goals. Write journal entries, save doodles, track progress, and keep inspiration in your Dream Vault — all in one peaceful place on your device.
features: Vision boards with categories and inspiration items
Dream journal for daily reflection
Doodle Dreams drawing pad with saved drawings
Dream Tracker for goals and milestones
Dream Vault for photos, notes, and favorites
Export and import JSON backups from Settings
Private on-device storage — no account required
marketing.builtFor: Dreamy Board is built for gentle everyday dreaming. It is calm, creative, and private — a soft companion for planning your next chapter without pressure or clutter.

extraSections.title: Photos and Photo Library
extraSections.body: Dreamy Board may request access to your photo library only when you choose to add images to vision boards or the Dream Vault. Images you add stay on your device as part of your personal content. We do not sell your photos.

extraSections.title: Backups and Data Deletion
extraSections.body: You can export a JSON backup from Settings at any time. You can delete all app data using Settings → Clear All Data, by clearing the app’s stored data in device Settings, or by uninstalling the app. For privacy questions or deletion help, email thegiftedgirlkim@gmail.com.

plannedFeatures: Cloud backup option in a future update
Print and share vision board layouts

faqs.question: Is my dream journal private?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your journals, boards, doodles, goals, and vault items stay on your device. We do not upload them to our servers.

faqs.question: How do I back up my dreams?
faqs.answer: Open Settings → Export Backup. You can save the JSON file to Files, email it to yourself, or re-import it later on the same or a new device.

faqs.question: How do I contact support?
faqs.answer: Email thegiftedgirlkim@gmail.com with your app version and device type (iPhone or Android). We're happy to help.

faqs.question: How do I leave a review?
faqs.answer: Once Dreamy Board is live on the App Store or Google Play, open Settings → Leave a Review in the app, or find Dreamy Board on the store and tap Rate & Review. Thank you for supporting indie apps!

mobile-eyes.dataCollected: Mobile Eyes is a caregiver safety prototype. Location and alert features may use device permissions when enabled. Data is used only to provide safety features — not for advertising.
mobile-eyes.thirdPartyServices: Backend services may be limited during development. Location services use platform APIs.
knownIssues: Prototype — backend features may be limited.
Not intended as a substitute for emergency services.

faqs.question: Is Mobile Eyes a medical or emergency service?
faqs.answer: No. Mobile Eyes is a companion prototype for families. Always call emergency services (911) for emergencies.

gem-and-me.dataCollected: Gem & Me stores progress locally on your device: XP, streaks, life quests, trivia scores, achievements, and recent chat history. No account is required. When you use AI chat, the messages you send are transmitted to our AI provider (Groq) to generate Gem's replies. Free users have a daily AI message limit.
gem-and-me.thirdPartyServices: AI chat is powered by Groq (llama-3.1-8b-instant on the free tier). Groq processes chat text under their privacy policy. Apple App Store / Google Play handle billing when subscriptions are offered in the future. No advertising SDKs.

extraSections.title: AI Chat & Daily Limits
extraSections.body: Chat with Gem sends your message text to Groq's API. Please avoid sharing passwords or highly sensitive personal information. Free users receive 15 AI messages per day; trivia, quests, battles, and other features remain available without that limit. Offline mode uses scripted replies only — nothing is sent online.

extraSections.title: Data Stored On Your Device
extraSections.body: Level, XP, streak, quest checkmarks, trivia stats, battle wins, and recent chat bubbles are saved in your device's local storage. You can clear this by removing the app or clearing app data on your device.

knownIssues: Android test builds are installed via APK sideload until Play Store launch.
Store review links activate after App Store / Google Play publication.
plannedFeatures: Optional premium tier with higher AI limits

faqs.question: Does Gem & Me share my conversations?
faqs.answer: We do not sell your chats. AI messages are sent to Groq only to generate replies. Progress and trivia data stay on your device unless a future feature clearly discloses cloud sync.

faqs.question: Why is there a daily chat limit?
faqs.answer: The free tier includes 15 AI messages per day so Gem stays sustainable while the app is free to download. Trivia Arena, Life Quests, Gem vs Me, and other areas are not limited the same way.

faqs.question: How do I leave a review?
faqs.answer: Once Gem & Me is on the App Store or Google Play, use the review option in the app Profile. Until then, email us — we love hearing what you think!

snow-patrol.dataCollected: Snow Patrol stores game progress locally on your device. We do not collect personal information for advertising.
snow-patrol.thirdPartyServices: Apple App Store / Google Play when published. No advertising SDKs.
knownIssues: In active development — gameplay and performance may vary by device.

faqs.question: Who is Snow?
faqs.answer: Snow is Kimberly's Siberian Husky and the heart of Snow Patrol — a playful, heartfelt adventure inspired by real life.

widget-guru-studio.dataCollected: Widget Guru Studio stores favorites, widget configuration, and app preferences locally on your device. When you save a wallpaper, the image is written to your photo library with your permission. If you choose a city for weather widgets, that city preference is stored on your device. We do not collect, upload, or sell personal information.
widget-guru-studio.thirdPartyServices: No third-party analytics or advertising SDKs. Optional weather widgets request forecast data from Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com) using the city you choose — used only to display weather in the app. Apple App Store / Google Play billing when applicable.

extraSections.title: Weather (optional)
extraSections.body: Some widgets (such as Sky Glance and Day Board) can show weather. If you choose a city, the app stores that city or location preference on your device and requests forecast data from Open-Meteo, a third-party weather service. We do not create an Open-Meteo account for you. Weather data is used only to display conditions in the app. Location is not used for advertising or tracking.

knownIssues: Home screen widgets require platform-specific setup — follow in-app Guru Tips.
Wallpaper styles include both photo backgrounds and curated color gradients.
plannedFeatures: New wallpaper collections in future updates

faqs.question: How much content is in the current version?
faqs.answer: Version 1.1.0 includes 132 wallpaper styles, 19 widget styles, 24 theme packs, and 37 quote cards, plus Guru Tips and favorites. More content is added in updates.

faqs.question: Does Widget Guru Studio upload my favorites?
faqs.answer: No. Favorites and widget configs stay on your device. Nothing is uploaded to our servers.

faqs.question: Why does the app ask for Photos access?
faqs.answer: Only when you tap Save to Gallery on a wallpaper. The app does not read your entire photo library.

faqs.question: Does the app use my location for weather?
faqs.answer: Weather is optional. You choose a city in the app. That preference stays on your device, and the app requests forecast data from Open-Meteo to display weather. It is not used for ads or tracking.

faqs.question: Is this the same as Widget Me?
faqs.answer: No. Widget Guru Studio is a new app with a new bundle ID (com.thegiftedgirlkim.widgetgurustudio) published by The Gifted Girl Kim LLC.

memories411.dataCollected: Memories411 stores your content on your device: 411 interview answers, photo memories, timeline entries, favorites, and Family Album photos you add. Family album codes are generated locally. We do not collect this content for advertising or resale.
memories411.thirdPartyServices: No third-party advertising SDKs. Apple App Store / Google Play when published. Family Album cloud sync (v2) will be disclosed in-app before use.

marketing.headline: Every picture tells a story.
intro: Memories411 helps your family save the stories behind the photos — guided by Mr. Polaroid, your warm gallery companion.
Answer weekly 411 interview questions, build a colorful timeline, collect photos in Family Album, and revisit memories On This Day. Your first family story takes just a few minutes.
features: 411 Interview Cards — weekly questions that turn into saved stories
Story Vault — your family's 411 answers in one place
Timeline — your history in color, with memories you add yourself
Family Album — local photo sharing with a family code (cloud sync in v2)
On This Day — memories that match today's date, or gentle prompts to start one
Photo Memories — add real photos from your library
Private on-device storage in v1 — no account required

extraSections.title: Health data
extraSections.body: With your permission, AI Fitness 411 requests read-only access to steps, heart rate, distance, Active Calories Burned (active energy/calories), and workouts from Apple Health (HealthKit) or Health Connect (which may include data your watch shares into that service). This data is used only to display your activity and fitness progress inside AI Fitness 411. Active Calories Burned represents calories burned through physical activity and is displayed as part of your daily activity progress. The app does not write to Apple Health or Health Connect. You can revoke access in system Health / Health Connect settings. Separately, if you use AI Coach, numeric metrics already available in the app may be included in that Coach request (see AI Coach & meal scanning).

extraSections.title: AI Coach & meal scanning
extraSections.body: AI Coach (Hydro/Flex) may send your prompt, coach context, and a short metrics snapshot to DeepSeek and/or Groq to generate a reply. Meal, barcode, or nutrition-label scanning may send the photo you take to Groq for an estimate. These AI requests are for that feature only and are not used by us to train a permanent chat archive in AI Fitness 411.

extraSections.title: Camera
extraSections.body: Camera access is used when you choose meal, barcode, or nutrition-label scanning. Photos are not required for core logging.

extraSections.title: AI Flag / content reports
extraSections.body: If you tap Flag on an AI Coach reply and submit a report, the app saves it to our Supabase database table used for AI Fitness 411 reports. A successful Flag means the report was stored. Saved fields can include: report category, optional note, a short copy of your prompt, an excerpt of the AI reply, coach persona, app version, guest flag, status, and created time. Reports are not tied to a user account. Reports may be reviewed and marked during the retention period. Email (mailto) is offered only if saving the report fails — it is not the primary path.

extraSections.title: Subscriptions (Premium)
extraSections.body: Optional Premium is a monthly auto-renewable subscription sold through the Apple App Store or Google Play (product ID aifitness411_premium_monthly). Payment is handled by Apple or Google. Subscriptions renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your store account settings. Restoring purchases is available in the app. Deleting local app data does not cancel a subscription.

extraSections.title: Deleting Your Data
extraSections.body: In Profile, use Delete all local data to erase your profile, meals, water, workouts, and caches on this device. Free AI Coach preview counts are kept so deleting data is not a subscription bypass. You can also clear the app’s storage in device Settings or uninstall the app. This does not cancel an active Apple or Google subscription. AI Flag reports already submitted are stored in our developer database (Supabase) for safety review for up to 90 days from submission, then deleted automatically. Flag reports are guest submissions and are not linked to a user account, so the app cannot offer a self-serve Flag-delete button and we do not promise email-based Flag deletion. Delete all local data does not remove Flag reports that were already saved.

extraSections.title: Data Retention
extraSections.body:
Fitness logs, profile information, meals, water, workouts, weight, settings, and other locally stored app data remain on your device until you delete them using "Delete all local data," clear the app’s storage, or uninstall the app. AI Fitness 411 does not maintain a cloud account containing this local fitness history.

AI Flag reports submitted for safety review are stored in our developer database for up to 90 days from submission and are then automatically deleted. AI Flag reports are guest submissions and are not linked to a user account.

Information sent to third-party services for AI processing is subject to the applicable service provider’s data-handling practices as described in this policy.

faqs.question: What is free vs Premium?

faqs.answer: Open Premium in the app and tap Restore purchases. Purchases are handled by Apple or Google.

faqs.answer: No. Delete all local data only erases on-device data and does not cancel subscriptions. It also does not remove AI Flag reports already saved for safety review. Flag reports are kept up to 90 days, then deleted automatically.

faqs.question: What health data does the app read?
faqs.answer: With permission, read-only steps, heart rate, distance, active energy/calories, and workouts from Apple Health or Health Connect. The app does not write health data back.

faqs.question: What happens when I Flag an AI Coach reply?
faqs.answer: The report is saved in-app to our developer database (Supabase) for review. Fields can include category, note, prompt, reply excerpt, persona, and app version. Guest Flag reports are not linked to an account. They are retained up to 90 days, then deleted automatically. Mailto is only a fallback if saving fails.
